name: buscar_socios
description: Search the fictional members by partial first or last name. Returns at most limit rows (default 50, maximum 200).

name: buscar_socios_por_localidad
description: Search fictional members by locality or province and optionally include inactive members. Returns at most limit rows (default 50, maximum 200).

name: contexto_cliente
description: Read the selected account context before business queries. Returns the synthetic Celesol DEMO identity and fixed work date. Does not inspect any Vimarx database or other connection.

name: es_fecha_habil
description: Check the illustrative demo calendar: weekends and 2026-10-12 are nonworking days. This is not the real Vimarx holiday calendar. Dates use yyyy-MM-dd.

name: get_amt_socio
description: List the fictional AMT term deposits for a demo member, with capital, currency, term, fixed rate, maturity and status. Does not simulate interest calculations or deposit transactions.

name: get_cuentas_amv
description: List the fictional AMV savings accounts of a demo member, including currency, balance and status.

name: get_cuotas_prestamo
description: Read fictional loan installments and current outstanding balances. fecha (yyyy-MM-dd) determines overdue status; demo penalty interest is always zero. Returns DeudaTotal and Vencido. This illustrative calculation does not reproduce the Vimarx financial engine. No payment or collection tool is available.

name: get_dias_habiles
description: Count days inclusively using the illustrative demo calendar, optionally counting Saturdays as half-days. Weekends and 2026-10-12 are otherwise nonworking days. Maximum interval is 3660 days.

name: get_domicilio
description: Read the fictional address, locality and province of a demo member.

name: get_entidades
description: List synthetic entities available in this demo, optionally filtered by name. Use the exact returned entity name with get_propiedades and query_entidad.

name: get_estadisticas
description: Read demo member totals: number of AMV accounts and loans, aggregate savings balance and outstanding loan balance.

name: get_estado_instalacion
description: Read the synthetic installation identity, work date and dataset version. Does not inspect schemas, modules, servers or real databases, including when incluirEsquema is provided.

name: get_fecha_trabajo
description: Read the fixed work date of the synthetic dataset: 2026-10-30.

name: get_herencia_entidad
description: Read illustrative inheritance and available fields for a synthetic entity. Does not describe real XAF inheritance or SQL table mappings.

name: get_lineas_prestamo
description: Read the fictional loan lines, optionally filtered by validity or calculation-system label. Does not create loan applications or simulate a real repayment schedule.

name: get_movimientos
description: Read fictional AMV movements, filtered by member, account, dates, movement type or pending status. Dates use yyyy-MM-dd. Returns newest first and at most limit rows (default 50, maximum 200). Fixtures have no archived historical movements.

name: get_prestamos
description: Read the fictional loans of a demo member, with account number, currency, capital, outstanding balance and status. Demo member 900001 has one overdue loan, 910001.

name: get_propiedades
description: Read the available fields and simple data types of an exact synthetic entity. Use these fields to build queries; no production schema or real enum catalog is exposed.

name: get_socio_por_cuit
description: Read a fictional member by CUIT, or return null if absent.

name: get_socio_por_dni
description: Read a fictional member by document number, or return null if absent.

name: get_socio_por_numero
description: Read a fictional member by membership number, or return null if absent.

name: get_tasas_amt
description: Read the fixed illustrative AMT rate configuration, optionally filtering by type. Does not calculate a suggested rate from monto or plazo or evaluate real conditions.

name: get_version
description: Read the synthetic simulator version, not the production Vimarx server version.

name: get_vistas_modelo
description: Read illustrative demo ListView names and available columns. Does not inspect the real XAF application model or produce DetailViews.

name: query_entidad
description: Read synthetic rows using the exact entity and fields from get_entidades and get_propiedades. Criteria support comparisons, And/Or/Not, In, Contains, StartsWith, EndsWith and #ISO# dates. Projection supports simple fields or one Count/Sum/Avg/Min/Max aggregate with optional grouping. Other XPO functions, SQL and arbitrary expressions are unsupported. Maximum 200 rows. Unsupported queries fail locally without production fallback.

name: query_socios
description: Read fictional members using optional name, document, status or admission-date filters. Returns at most limit rows (default 50, maximum 200).
